summary: Greenpro Capital Corp. filed an 8-K reporting the closing of an acquisition of a 0.99% minority stake in Greenophene Technologies Limited (GTL) from individual seller Lim Chee Yin. Consideration was 800,000 restricted shares of Greenpro common stock valued at $1.50 per share, totaling $1.2 million, representing 4.5% of Greenpro's post-closing outstanding shares. The shares were issued privately under Rule 506(d). The transaction is a small, minority investment, not a controlling acquisition or special-situation event. No board recommendation, advisor, or premium was mentioned. The filing is a routine report of a material definitive agreement and an exempt stock issuance.
